page_title: GRA 0-2 RAY | Granada CF v Rayo Vallecano 21/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.

90+8' A cross by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

90+7' Great save! Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Stole Dimitrievski.
90+6' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' A pass finds the feet of Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) will replace Sergio Ruiz.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alberto Perea (Granada CF) is coming onto the pitch as Ricard Sanchez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Alvaro Garcia is going off and Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
88' Here comes a substitution. Florian Lejeune is given a rest as he is replaced by Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano).
86' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
84' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
83' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' Paco Lopez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) replacing Gerard Gumbau.
80' Substitution. Oscar Melendo will be replaced by Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF).

79' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) and Raul de Tomas gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the left side of the goal. 0:2.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Unai Lopez.
76' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!

75' 0 - 1 Unai Lopez is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the right post to make the score 0:1.
72' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

69' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
67' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
66' That's the end of the game for Oscar Trejo, who is replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
66' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Randy Nteka will be replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).
62' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jose Callejon.

62' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
58' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
56' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle as Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
54' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
52' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) latched on to a fine crossfield pass on the edge of the box and lashed a shot directly at the middle of the goal, where the keeper stood ready.
50' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
50' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.
47' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

43' A nice pass finds Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
42' The corner kick from Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
41' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but Andre Ferreira punches the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
40' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
37' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

34' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Stole Dimitrievski.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
31' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
28' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

27' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Andre Ferreira to dive and make a save. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
27' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Rayo Vallecano.
25' Flag up against Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
22' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

21' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Stole Dimitrievski. Granada CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Granada CF continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
17' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul after Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) hacks down one of his opponents. Granada CF have a free kick.
16' The Rayo Vallecano players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' Granada CF take a short corner kick.

14' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
13' The resulting corner from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared by the defence. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.

12' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Andre Ferreira to dive and make a save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
11' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) receives a yellow card for infringement.
10' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

8' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Granada CF.
6' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
5' A cross into the box from Jose Callejon (Granada CF) is cleared. Granada CF will take a corner kick.
4' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the bottom left corner that is easily dealt with by Andre Ferreira.
3' Granada CF work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Granada CF.
1' A terrific attempt by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes was nominated as the referee for this game.
